title: 1. Seismic interpretation
tech: U-Net fault detection and seeded horizon tracking, with confidence maps and well ties.
operator: Weeks of manual picking reduced to hours, with every pick traceable.

title: 2. Geomodel
tech: Facies and property modeling with seismic as secondary variable; cross-validated.
operator: A consistent, uncertainty-aware reservoir model to plan wells against.

title: 3. Fluids and PVT
tech: EOS/correlation PVT tuned to data, with phase envelopes and residuals.
operator: Realistic fluid behavior feeding recovery and EOR decisions.

title: 4. Simulation and surrogate
tech: Open-source simulator plus a surrogate validated against it; runs in the browser.
operator: Scenario answers in milliseconds, with the error shown.

title: 5. Forecast and risk
tech: Monte Carlo P10/P50/P90 and tornado sensitivity.
operator: Defensible ranges instead of single-number forecasts.

title: 6. Economics
tech: NPV and breakeven propagated from the forecast distribution.
operator: Development decisions tied to value and downside.
